FluentProvider.aesthetic: Root theme provider inheriting active SharePoint Online site palette and dark/light mode dynamically.

TabList.aesthetic: Fluent 2 TabList with subtle appearance, active indicator line, and small status Badge.

Accordion.aesthetic: Native Fluent 2 collapsible panels with expandIconPosition='end' and toolbar buttons.

Card.aesthetic: Elevated Fluent 2 card with subtle border, shadow hover lift, icon box, independent background color (with WCAG adaptive contrast), dynamic physical live resize preview badge (📐 cols × rows), and SharePoint native Move Web Part isolation.

MetricCard.aesthetic: High-contrast British financial metrics formatted in GBP (£) with trend badges.

CardEditDialog.aesthetic: Elevated modal dialog with shadow28, responsive form layout, icon picker, and action buttons.

FloatingTextToolbar.aesthetic: Subtle floating pill toolbar with mousedown blur prevention, site theme palette swatches, highlight background colors, and active formatting indicators.

FluentIconPicker.aesthetic: Visual icon selection modal featuring instant search, categorised pill filters, and 40+ Fluent UI 2 icons with hover animations.

RichTextEditable.aesthetic: Theme-aware inline WYSIWYG rich text block inheriting site font families and theme colors with real-time selection-anchored ribbon.

InsertionBar.aesthetic: Hover-activated horizontal line with centered circular (+) add button modeled after SharePoint section adder.

ToolboxModal.aesthetic: Grid of SharePoint authoring tools (Button, CTA, Divider, Editorial, Hero, Image, Video, Live Data, Term Store).

TermStorePicker.aesthetic: Managed metadata taxonomy browser with rounded tag pills, Skeleton shimmer during fetch, and search filtering.

LiveDataRenderer.aesthetic: Real-time API dynamic value display with live connectivity badge, Skeleton shimmer during loading, and refresh trigger.

Skeleton.aesthetic: Fluent UI 2 pulse shimmer animation preventing layout shifts during asynchronous data fetches.

ToastNotification.aesthetic: Layered surface toast notification with accent border-left, drop shadow28, and auto-dismiss feedback.

CardTagsCollapsible.aesthetic: Mini collapsible tile with tag icon, count badge, and chevron. Collapsed by default, expanding to reveal managed metadata and standard tag pills.

BrandColorPickerPopover.aesthetic: Fluent UI 2 visual popup color picker featuring categorized Turner & Townsend brand palettes (TT Primary, TT Secondary, Backgrounds & Neutrals, Brand Tints), active selection rings, preview swatch trigger button, and custom HEX input.
